The room is decorated with American flags and military service flags. A man in a suit approaches Trump from the side, shakes his hand, and the astronauts applaud.

on_screen_text.text: President Trump welcomes the Artemis II Astronauts to the Oval Office 🚀🇺🇸

spoken_summary: Donald Trump welcomes a group of people to the Oval Office, whom he calls brave astronauts that have 'captivated the attention of the whole world.' He expresses awe at their courage, saying 'I wouldn't want to do it,' and states that 'it takes people like this to make our country great.' He specifically congratulates a man named Jared for his work at NASA, saying, 'I made a great choice.' He concludes by praising the astronauts for their 'unbelievable courage' and intelligence.
